name: @chbrain/khai-composite-comic
description: khai composite content, the comic domain: the mirth comedy is built to produce -- a violation of expectation (surprise) held in a play frame that keeps it benign (humor), the amusement that compound answers with (emotion), and the crossing it makes into laughter when the frame holds and the violation lands -- with the two edges where the crossing fails, taken too hard as offense and too soft as flatness, read whole across the atom engines it depends on.

khai.tagline: The comic as composite: the mirth comedy is built to produce -- a violation of expectation (surprise) held in a play frame that keeps it benign (humor), the amusement that compound answers with (emotion), and the crossing it makes into laughter when the frame holds and the violation lands -- and the drama lives at the two edges where the crossing fails, taken too hard as offense and too soft as flatness.

card.wire: Attaches at Process, over three atoms it declares as dependencies. The root (process_comic.md) reads the comic emotion of a violation made safe: the surprise engine's violated expectation (the incongruity, the thing the model said would not happen), the humor engine's play stance (the frame that holds the violation as comedy rather than threat), and the emotion engine's felt charge (the mirth the compound discharges). The composite adds no fourth atom, only the read of the compound -- McGraw and Warren's benign violation, a wrong that is simultaneously okay -- and its crossing into laughter.
card.issue: Two bridge states the atoms cannot hold alone, the two edges the crossing fails at. Offense: the play frame collapses and the violation is taken as real, so the wrong lands as a threat or an affront with no remove to make it benign, and the witness is stung rather than amused. Flatness: the violation never lands and the moment is wholly safe, so the frame holds over nothing incongruous, and the witness is bored rather than amused.
card.require: Two altitudes hold the composite. The law: declared once in the project's Instructions Knowledge chapter, linking the root, so the comic read runs wherever its atoms are cast. The link, advisory: a persona stung into offense or left in flatness may link the bridge under Projection, and the audit surfaces the ones left unnamed.
card.enforce: Structure is checked; coherence is judged. The kit verifies the floor: the law is declared, the composite's own members conform, and every hard link into the atoms resolves through a declared dependency. Whether a production earns the comic -- lands a real violation held in a frame that keeps it benign, rather than collapsing into offense or into flatness -- is semantic, taught and reviewed, never failed by the suite.
card.setup: Install the composite; its three atoms arrive as dependencies and their laws with them. Declare the law in the Instructions Knowledge chapter, linking the root. Cast the violation from the surprise engine (the expectation broken), the frame from the humor engine (the play stance that keeps it benign), and the felt charge from the emotion engine (the mirth discharged), then read the compound and its crossing: a violation held benign crosses into laughter; taken too hard it is offense, taken too soft it is flatness. Read the production across the compound, never in the violation alone.
